clips.title: The story
paras: Lessons Anew is a rite of passage for young tauren druids, initiated by Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff. It directs apprentices to travel to the sacred haven of Moonglade to begin mastering the art of cleansing natural and unnatural poisons. Guided by the night elf Dendrite Starblaze, this lesson sets aside mock trials in favor of confronting an urgent, real-world poisoning crisis.

Druids hold a sacred mandate to protect the wilds, which includes the miraculous ability bestowed by Cenarius to purge virulent toxins with a simple incantation. However, such potent magic is not handed over without grounding. Turak Runetotem insists that before channeling divine energies to effortlessly dispel blights, a druid must understand the physical toll of venom and learn to treat it through grounded, mundane means.

Rather than conducting training solely on the bluffs of Mulgore, promising acolytes are sent north through sacred pathways to Moonglade. There, within the peaceful village of Nighthaven, ancient night elf mentors such as Dendrite Starblaze oversee the education of both elf and tauren practitioners. This shared instruction highlights the delicate truce that exists within the Cenarion Circle, rising above the political strife separating Horde and Alliance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, friend. Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. This gift is not to be taken lightly... And to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.
Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings young druid, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. There has been a rash of animal poisonings at the Crossroads in the Barrens, and they're unable to bring it under control. Someone there has requested Moonglade for aid, so we are sending you there to aid them. This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. Bear this in mind.
